_doc: The first hatch (onboarding_beats.dart HatchScreen, hatch_timeline.dart). Times in seconds from the tap. A beat can play a sound (sfx, vol), a haptic feel (buzz: a Haptic name), shake the egg (shake: strength 0-1), raise its cracks (crack: 1-3), burst it (burst), or start a reaction on the creature (react: emerge, look, hatch = its personality's signature). Phases: A quiet 0-0.5; B shaking 0.5-1.0, irregular (a small knock, a big one, an aftershock); a held breath 1.0-1.35 (nothing moves); C the cracks 1.35-2.1, each with its own jolt; a second held breath 2.1-2.5 while the light inside swells; D burst 2.5; E reveal 2.6-3.6; F payoff 3.6-4.9 (it looks round at its world, then its own act), then the name card. styles: each egg's light and the shape of its burst (motes, leaves, sparks, droplets, grit, stars); every burst also carries the gold Lumen motes.
